## Navigator Gas Publishes Independent Valuation Report in Connection with its Change of Domicile to England and Wales


November 25, 2026


LONDON, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Navigator Holdings Ltd. (described herein as “ **Navigator Gas** ” or the “ **Company** ”) (NYSE: NVGS) announced today that, in connection with its previously announced change in corporate domicile from the Marshall Islands to England and Wales, it is making available to its shareholders the independent accountants’ report prepared by Grant Thornton UK Advisory & Tax LLP (“ **Grant Thornton** ”) as required under section 593(1) of the UK Companies Act 2006 (the “ **Report** ”).


As previously announced, the change in corporate domicile will be effected by way of a merger, whereby the Company will merge with and into Navigator Gas Merger Co Inc., a Marshall Islands corporation (“ **Merger Sub** ”) and a wholly owned subsidiary of Navigator Gas plc, a public limited company incorporated under the laws of England and Wales (“ **New Parent** ”) and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, with Merger Sub surviving and continuing as a wholly owned subsidiary of New Parent (the “ **Merger** ”). At the effective time of the Merger, each share of common stock of the Company (“ **Common Shares** ”) will be exchanged for one ordinary share of New Parent having a nominal value of US$0.01 (“ **Ordinary Shares** ”). As a result of the Merger, New Parent will become the publicly traded parent company of the Navigator group of companies.


Under English law, as a result of the proposed issuance by New Parent of its Ordinary Shares in the Merger in exchange for the Common Shares of the Company, the Common Shares must be independently valued and a copy of the valuation report must be provided to the proposed allottees (the holders of the Common Shares).

The Merger is expected to be completed prior to year-end. The Ordinary Shares of New Parent are expected to commence trading on the NYSE on the following trading day under the same ‘NVGS’ ticker symbol under which the Common Shares of the Company are currently traded.


**About Navigator Gas**


Navigator Gas is the owner and operator of the world’s largest fleet of handysize liquefied gas carriers and a global leader in the seaborne transportation services of petrochemical gases, such as ethylene and ethane, liquefied petroleum gas and ammonia and owns a 50% share, through a joint venture, in an ethylene export marine terminal at Morgan’s Point, Texas on the Houston Ship Channel, USA. Navigator Gas’ fleet consists of 46 semi- or fully-refrigerated liquefied gas carriers, 18 of which are ethylene and ethane capable. The Company plays a vital role in the liquefied gas supply chain for energy companies, industrial consumers and commodity traders, with its sophisticated vessels providing an efficient and reliable ‘floating pipeline’ between the parties, connecting the world today, creating a sustainable tomorrow.


Navigator Gas’ Common Shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “NVGS”.
